buildCommand: npm run build -w @mandi/shared && npm run build -w @mandi/web

rewrites.comment: Single-page app. Vercel serves real files first, so this only catches routes like /farmer/queue that React Router owns.

headers.comment: The service worker must never be served stale, or a deploy cannot replace the one already installed on a phone.
Build assets are content-hashed, so they can be cached forever.
